sourcePolicy: Fineli supplies available carbohydrate quantities only. GI evidence is stored as individual, traceable records: STRONG records must be published, glucose-scale, ISO 26642-confirmed and preparation-matched; SUPPLEMENTARY records are for internal comparison and never produce a public GL. Do not copy complete source tables or substitute unmatched foods/preparations.
